message.content:
The **Union Square Greenmarket** is widely regarded as the most visited market in New York City.  
It’s the largest and longest‑running farmers’ market in the city, drawing roughly 1 million visitors each year. The market operates every Saturday (and on select holidays) from 8 a.m. to 2 p.m., offering a wide variety of fresh produce, artisanal foods, and local products. Its central location in Manhattan’s Union Square, combined with its reputation for quality and variety, makes it a top destination for both locals and tourists.
